_about: Skyscrapers layer, 150 m (492 ft) and taller, Toronto's cut-off: about 20 towers, from Salesforce Tower (326 m) down. engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches the Wikipedia list; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/sf/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Table names are checked against the fetch log. No tower is under construction in San Francisco (October 2026), so "uc" is null; set it to the Wikipedia section when one appears.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in San Francisco

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out.
